producedAfterTheRolloutNote: The runbook requires this artifact, its hash and this smoke BEFORE a live rollout. The rollout of 2026-08-23 went ahead without them; this receipt closes that gap after the fact and must not be read as compliance at the time of the rollout.

provenance.note: Every field under `smoke` below is copied verbatim from the tool's own output. Re-running `reproduceWith` reproduces them, apart from the pid, the port and the timestamps inside the log tail.

build.verifiabilityNote: The build output is gitignored, so this hash cannot be checked out of the repository. What is checkable is its provenance: the recorded head plus the build command below reproduce a build, and the tool re-hashes whatever build is present each time it runs.

smoke.target: isolated online-backup copy of the live database; the live file is read only
smoke.portAndPathOverridden: the profile pins port 7717 and data/tabhub.sqlite; the smoke overrode both so it could run beside the daily server
smoke.tableCountRuleNote: Excludes sqlite_sequence, which SQLite maintains itself. The rollout and backup receipts count every table in sqlite_master and therefore report one more.
smoke.noWriterRanNote: Emitted by the tool as `rowCountsChangedWhileServing.length === 0`: every one of the counted tables held the same number of rows before and after the profile served. It is a measured comparison, not an assurance.
